verdict.rationale: Mercury documents user-defined rules in two narrow areas: categorization rules created via Mercury Command, which auto-categorize incoming transactions, and multi-layered approval rules that route bills for approval. There is no general-purpose event-to-action rule builder; the accounting API and MCP layer are only announced as coming 'soon'. Missing for 10: a general event-trigger/action rule engine, documentation of rule conditions and supported events, actions beyond categorization and approvals, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Use Mercury Command to bulk assign GL codes, create categorization rules, and more
Set up multi-layered approval rules and approve bills right inside Slack or Mercury's mobile app.
